text: On June 23, 2026, the Government of Canada, the Province of Ontario, and the Mayor of Toronto confirmed $1.5 billion in funding for the City over 10 years through the Development Charges Reduction Program, as part of the Canada-Ontario Partnership to Build. The Development Charges Reduction Program will provide the City of Toronto with federal and provincial infrastructure funding to support existing housing-enabling growth-related capital projects already included in the City's 10-Year Capital Plan. The funding will reduce reliance on development charges that would otherwise support these projects, thereby enabling time-limited development charges residential rate reductions of 40 percentt to 60 percent for over a three-year period to reduce development costs, enhance viability and increase housing supply.
